footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to APA: after $258M attributable to noncontrolling interests. The income statement has no operating income line; it is shown here as revenue less the operating expense lines, with interest and other non-operating items below it. The filing reports no separate capital expenditures, so free cash flow equals operating cash flow.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 5.3% to $9.2B in 2025. Gross margin was 83.8%, versus 84.8% a year earlier, and operating income rose 81.8% to $2.8B, a 30.3% margin.
Net income rose 78.4% to $1.4B, or $3.99 per share. Operating cash flow was $4.5B and free cash flow $4.5B, versus $3.6B; APA returned $360M through dividends.
sources: APA Corporation Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
